chunks: And it is narrated: “The bearers of the Throne today are four. One of them is in the form of a rooster, seeking sustenance from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, for the birds; one is in the form of a lion, seeking sustenance from Allah, Exalted is He, for the wild beasts; one is in the form of a bull, seeking sustenance from Allah, Exalted is He, for the livestock; and one of them is in the form of the children of Adam, seeking sustenance from Allah, Exalted is He, for the children of Adam عليه السلام. Then, when the Day of Resurrection comes, they will become eight. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said:”
“And the Throne of your Lord, above them, on that Day, will be carried by eight.”

key_terms.الثَّوْرِ: the bull-form mentioned for one bearer
key_terms.الدِّيكِ: the rooster-form mentioned for one bearer
key_terms.الْأَسَدِ: the lion-form mentioned for one bearer
key_terms.ثَمَانِيَةٌ: eight, the number of bearers on that Day
key_terms.حَمَلَةَ الْعَرْشِ: the bearers of the Divine Throne
key_terms.يَسْتَرْزِقُ: seeks sustenance from Allah for others

ai.seo_question: Who are the bearers of the Throne, and how many will carry it on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This report describes the present bearers of the Throne as four, each associated with a class of creatures and their sustenance, and states that on the Day of Resurrection they will be eight. It concludes by citing the Qur'anic verse affirming that the Throne of your Lord will on that Day be borne by eight.
